inputs.text: The owner explicitly approved implementing and installing MONOKL as a distinct native MOZAK research adapter, including catalog and setup support, normalization, a bounded runner, contract tests, and one verified local binding.

At repository revision 59911664bca48008e9dc238c9eeaac29948e76cc, MOZAK supports arxiv, dair-ai, mcp-registry, github-tooling, and hyperresearch adapters. MONOKL is installed locally and preserves the HyperResearch-compatible vault and JSON export surface, but MOZAK has no distinct monokl adapter identity, normalizer, setup route, runner, or binding.

The adapter must read only a finished local MONOKL vault, retain identity, provenance, locators and hashes rather than note bodies, perform no networking, declare no mutation or irreversible effect, produce proposal-only research evidence, and never promote or accept results automatically.
